title: Multiclass Hate Speech Detection with RoBERTa-OTA: Integrating Transformer Attention and Graph Convolutional Networks
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion' as a core category in its multiclass classification task. It develops an ontological framework that specifically incorporates 'religious/belief targeting' as a feature and evaluates the model's performance on a dataset of religion-based hate speech, analyzing its ability to handle theological terminology.
